                                                  M

                                                  Megatix (megatix.in.th)

                                                  Parties and tickets

                                                  Ticket website for most of your nights: Café del Mar shows, DnB Allstars, OXA, Jungle Experience and Hollystone. The e-ticket is a PDF with a QR code, sent by email.

                                                  At home
                                                  No app needed. Make a free account on megatix.in.th at home and buy early: the cheaper first releases sell out, then prices go up.
                                                  Works
                                                  Phuket: Café del Mar (Kamala), DnB Allstars (Azulea, Chalong, 22 to 24 Jan). Koh Phangan: OXA, Jungle Experience, Hollystone. Online, anywhere.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Free account. A service fee is added at checkout. DnB Allstars lists card, PromptPay QR and TrueMoney as payment.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • The 'Megatix' app in the stores is a ticket scanner for organisers. You do not need it.
                                                  • The PDF comes by email right after you pay. Lost it? Log in, click your name at the top, choose 'Tickets' and download it again.
                                                  • Show the QR on your phone and zoom in so the whole code is on screen. Each ticket lets one person in, once.
                                                  • Use megatix.in.th. The address megatix.co.th is a parked domain, not Megatix.
                                                  • Café del Mar, Hollystone, Jungle Experience and DnB Allstars pages say 20+, OXA pages say 18+. DnB Allstars checks ID: non-Thais need a passport.
                                                  • The ticket name is the buyer's account. DnB Allstars allows transfers only by its name-change process, up to 7 days before 22 Jan.
                                                  • Café del Mar sells through a Megatix box on its own event pages. For big names, sign up there to get presale access.

                                                  Good to have 23 apps

                                                  B

                                                  Bolt: Request a Ride

                                                  Getting around

                                                  Second ride app. Often cheaper than Grab, so compare both before each ride. Has XL and Van cars for groups of up to 6.

                                                  At home
                                                  Install at home and sign up with your phone number and the code it sends. Add a card, but also carry cash.
                                                  Works
                                                  Phuket. At Phuket airport only drop-offs at the terminal; for pickups you walk out of the airport gate. Koh Phangan: no. Koh Samui and Natai: not confirmed.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Free app. Fares shown before you book.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • 2026 guides say Bolt is often 5-30% cheaper than Grab in Phuket. Check both apps.
                                                  • Bolt drivers cannot pick up at the airport terminal. They wait outside the airport gate, a 5-10 minute walk with bags.
                                                  • Bolt's Thai licence ran out in May 2026. In July it still ran on a temporary permit while the Land Transport Department decides. Keep Grab ready.
                                                  • In early Sep 2026 Bolt briefly paused rides in Thailand to update driver records. Check that the app finds cars before you rely on it.
                                                  • Card payment works, but many Phuket drivers prefer cash. Carry small notes.
                                                  • Phuket ride types: Economy, Bolt, XL and Van (up to 6 people), and Taxi. You can schedule a ride from 30 minutes to 90 days ahead.
                                                  • Safety: the Emergency Assist button, and 'Share location' sends your car and live position to a friend.
                                                  Bolt in Phuket (official) ↗Bolt rides: booking ahead and safety ↗

                                                  P

                                                  Phuket Smart Bus

                                                  Getting around

                                                  Cheap bus along the west coast: Airport - Surin - Kamala - Patong - Karon - Kata - Rawai for 100 baht (≈1,100 AMD). Live bus map on the website. No app needed.

                                                  At home
                                                  Nothing to install. Bookmark the live map (phuketsmartbus.com/tracking). Have a contactless card or small notes.
                                                  Works
                                                  Phuket only. Route 1 starts outside the domestic terminal at HKT (Exit 3) and stops in Kamala. No stop in Nai Yang. Not on Koh Samui or Koh Phangan.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Route 1: 100 baht (≈1,100 AMD) flat. Route 2: 50 baht (≈540 AMD). Dragon Line: free. Route 1 pass: 299 baht (≈3,200 AMD) for 1 day, 799 for 7 days.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • From the airport every 30 minutes, 08:15-23:30. Last bus from Rawai to the airport 19:30. Times change with traffic.
                                                  • Airport to Kamala takes about 50 minutes. Kamala to the airport: first bus about 06:15, last about 20:35 (Big C Kamala), about 1 hour 15 minutes.
                                                  • At the airport: go out at Exit 3 of the domestic terminal, turn left and follow the public transport walkway to the blue Smart Bus sign.
                                                  • Pay on board: tap a contactless Visa, Mastercard or JCB card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay cash. The QR is for Thai bank apps (PromptPay).
                                                  • Route 2 runs Bus Terminal 2 - Phuket Town - Patong (50 baht, ≈540 AMD). The Dragon Line in Old Town is free.
                                                  • Help: LINE @pksb or WhatsApp +66 86 306 1257.
                                                  • The Android app called 'Phuket Smart Bus' is unofficial. Use the website instead.
                                                  Live bus map ↗Timetable ↗Fares and payment ↗Day passes ↗Find the bus stop at the airport ↗

                                                  K

                                                  Koh Phangan songthaews and taxis (no app)

                                                  Getting around

                                                  Ride apps do not work reliably on Koh Phangan. You use shared songthaew pickup trucks, private taxis and taxi boats. Always agree the price before you get in.

                                                  At home
                                                  Nothing to install. Ask your Ban Tai hotel for a driver's WhatsApp or LINE before you arrive.
                                                  Works
                                                  Koh Phangan only: Thong Sala pier, Ban Tai, Haad Rin and the party venues.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Shared truck about 200 baht (≈2,200 AMD) per person from Thong Sala to Haad Rin (2026 guides); more late at night and on party nights.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • Do not count on Grab, Bolt or inDrive here: there are no or almost no drivers.
                                                  • Songthaews wait at Thong Sala pier, mostly when boats arrive. Tell the driver where you go and agree the price per person.
                                                  • Save the number of a good driver on day one, or ask your hotel to call one. Private taxis cost more than shared trucks.
                                                  • Trucks get rare after dark. On Full Moon night they run through the night, but prices go up and they fill up fast. Plan the ride home.
                                                  • Taxi boats serve beaches on the north and east coast.
                                                  • Easier arrival: Lomprayah and Seatran sell boat tickets with a van to your Koh Phangan hotel (not Thong Nai Pan), 670-700 baht (≈7,200-7,600 AMD) from Samui airport.
                                                  P

                                                  Phuket airport taxi and limousine counters

                                                  Ferries, flights and airport

                                                  Official counters at Phuket airport: fixed-price limousine cars and minibuses, metered taxis and shared minibuses. Easy for the big group on 8 Jan.

                                                  At home
                                                  Optional: book a fixed-price car or a minibus for the group online before the flight.
                                                  Works
                                                  Phuket airport (HKT), both terminals, right after the arrivals exit. Rides to all of Phuket, and to Natai and other provinces.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Car (up to 3): Nai Yang 400, Kamala 750, Patong 800 baht (≈8,600 AMD). Minibus (up to 10): Kamala 1,300. Taxi: meter + 100 baht (≈1,100 AMD).
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • Phuket Airport Limousine has counters at the domestic exit Gate 1 and the international exit Gate 2. Prices are fixed and shown before you pay.
                                                  • Prices on its website (Oct 2026), car for up to 3: Phuket Town 650, Kamala 750, Patong 800, Kata 1,000 baht (≈10,800 AMD). SUV for 4 (07:00-18:00 only): Kamala 1,100.
                                                  • Minibus for 5-10 people: Nai Yang 600, Kamala 1,300, Patong 1,400 baht (≈15,100 AMD). Pay online by card, PromptPay or e-wallet, or at the counter.
                                                  • Metered taxis wait outside the terminal at the 'Metered Taxi' sign. You pay the meter plus a 100-baht (≈1,100 AMD) airport fee.
                                                  • Shared minibus (P.M.K. counter), per person: 150 baht (≈1,600 AMD) to Phuket Town, 180 to Patong, 200 to Kata or Rawai (official airport list).
                                                  • EVme electric VIP taxis: counter in the domestic terminal, level 1, Public Transport Center. Meter from 150 baht (≈1,600 AMD) plus the 100-baht (≈1,100 AMD) airport fee.
                                                  HKT transport options (official) ↗Phuket Airport Limousine: prices and booking ↗Where the limousine counters are ↗

                                                  Seatran Discovery

                                                  Ferries, flights and airport

                                                  Second ferry company from Samui to Koh Phangan, with vans from Samui airport. Use it when Lomprayah times or seats do not fit.

                                                  At home
                                                  If you use it, book on seatrandiscovery.com or 12Go at home and save the booking on your phone.
                                                  Works
                                                  Check-in counters at Samui airport (Smack One counter), Bangrak pier (Samui) and Thong Sala pier (Koh Phangan).

                                                  Samui airport to Thong Sala 500 baht (≈5,400 AMD); Thong Sala to Bangrak pier 350 baht (≈3,800 AMD); Samui airport to your Koh Phangan hotel 670 baht (≈7,200 AMD) (booking site, Jan 2027).
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • Samui airport to Thong Sala on 19 Jan 2027: 07:30, 09:00, 12:00 and 14:00. The trip takes 1 to 1.25 hours.
                                                  • Thong Sala to Samui airport on 23 Jan 2027: 10:30 and 11:00 (at the airport 12:00 or 12:30), then 16:00 and 16:45.
                                                  • No app in the stores. Help: LINE Official, ebooking@seatrandiscovery.com, +66 86 476 4825.

                                                  1

                                                  12Go Train Bus Ferry Flight

                                                  Ferries, flights and airport

                                                  Booking app for ferries, buses, vans, transfers and flights in Thailand, incl. Phuket to Koh Phangan routes. Good to compare times and operators.

                                                  At home
                                                  Install at home and make an account. After booking, save the PDF voucher on your phone (offline).
                                                  Works
                                                  Online. Covers Phuket, Koh Samui and Koh Phangan routes (Lomprayah, Seatran and others).
                                                  Cost
                                                  Free app. Ferry tickets can cost about 50-100 baht (≈540-1,100 AMD) more than on the operator's own site.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • Look for the 'e-ticket' sign on the trip. Then the PDF on your phone is enough. Without it, print the voucher or swap it for a ticket at the counter.
                                                  • Compare the price with Lomprayah and Seatran's own sites before you pay.
                                                  • Check the pier name: Samui has several piers (Bangrak, Nathon, Maenam/Pralarn). Also check the check-in place and time on your voucher.
                                                  • Pay by card (3D Secure), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay or PromptPay. If something goes wrong on the trip, call the phone number on your voucher.
                                                  Do I have to print anything? (12Go help) ↗Thailand ferry tickets (12Go help) ↗

                                                  Organic Maps: Offline Map & GPS

                                                  Maps and language

                                                  Backup map that works fully offline, incl. search and walking directions. Good on Koh Phangan when Google Maps has no signal.

                                                  At home
                                                  At home on Wi-Fi, download the maps for Phuket and the Samui islands in the app.
                                                  Works
                                                  Everywhere, also with no signal.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Free, no account.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • Search and navigation work without internet, also on foot.
                                                  • Maps come from OpenStreetMap and are updated about every two weeks.
                                                  • You can import and record routes.

                                                  M

                                                  myAIS (AIS Tourist SIM and eSIM)

                                                  Phone and internet

                                                  AIS tourist SIM or eSIM: unlimited 5G/4G data, a Thai number, free calls to AIS numbers, 100 baht (≈1,100 AMD) call credit and AIS Super WiFi. The myAIS app shows your balance, tops up and sells packages.

                                                  At home
                                                  eSIM: make an account at ais.th/esim-traveller, pass the passport photo and selfie check (1 to 48 hours), pay, then send the QR code to your email. Start a few days before the flight.
                                                  Works
                                                  AIS counters at Phuket airport (international hall, 1st floor, at the baggage belts), Samui airport, and AIS and Telewiz shops. The network works in Phuket, Samui and Koh Phangan.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Tourist plans (16 Oct 2026): 8 days 499, 15 days 699, 30 days 1,199, 60 days 1,599 baht (≈17,300 AMD) (60 days only as a SIM card). For 8-26 Jan take 30 days.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • You cannot get a refund after you pay for the AIS eSIM (AIS terms).
                                                  • With only one phone, use the 'Activation code' from the email instead of scanning the QR code.
                                                  • Reviews on the AIS eSIM site say the passport photo check can fail. If it does, buy a SIM at the AIS airport counter.
                                                  • Your phone must support eSIM and be unlocked.
                                                  • Keep your home SIM on for bank SMS codes, but turn off its data roaming so you do not pay roaming fees.
                                                  • AIS call centre: 1175.

                                                  True (True and dtac Tourist SIM)

                                                  Phone and internet

                                                  True and dtac (one company now) sell tourist SIMs and eSIMs with unlimited data, free local calls (up to 15 minutes each) and a Thai number. The True app shows balance and usage.

                                                  At home
                                                  Buy the eSIM online at store.true.th or a True partner site, or buy at the airport counter with your passport. Check that your phone supports eSIM.
                                                  Works
                                                  True counters at Phuket airport (international arrivals at baggage belt 4, and domestic arrivals) and dtac counters at arrival exits 1-2. Top up at 7-Eleven or True shops all over Thailand, also on Koh Phangan.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Tourist plans (16 Oct 2026): 15 days 699 baht (≈7,500 AMD), 30 days 1,199 baht (≈12,900 AMD). Data-only 10 days: 349 baht (≈3,800 AMD) (no outgoing calls or SMS).
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • THIM app users get a free 1-day SIM and 30 days for 1,150 baht (≈12,400 AMD) at True and dtac airport counters, also in Phuket. True's page gives two end dates: 31 Dec 2026 and 31 Mar 2027.
                                                  • Check your balance with *123#. See your Thai number with *833#. True call centre: 1242.
                                                  • To top up at 7-Eleven, tell the staff your number and the amount (20, 50, 100 or 300 baht, ≈3,200 AMD).
                                                  • The True app works for both True and dtac numbers.

                                                  A

                                                  Airalo: eSIM for travel & data

                                                  Phone and internet

                                                  eSIM app. Buy a Thailand data plan at home, install it on Wi-Fi and switch it on when you land. Data only: you get no Thai phone number.

                                                  At home
                                                  Check that your phone supports eSIM and is unlocked. Buy and install the eSIM at home on Wi-Fi. In Thailand, choose it as your data line.
                                                  Works
                                                  All of Thailand on the True and AIS networks (Airalo, Oct 2026), including Koh Phangan and Samui.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Unlimited plans on the UK site (16 Oct 2026): 15 days 30.50 GBP, 30 days 38.50 GBP. A 30-day AIS or True tourist SIM costs 1,199 baht (≈12,900 AMD), about 27 GBP.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • Unlimited plans can have a fair-use rule that slows the speed after a daily amount. Read the package details before you buy.
                                                  • Most eSIMs can be installed only once. Do not delete it from your phone before the trip ends.
                                                  • Holafly and Saily also sell Thailand eSIMs. Compare the price for your number of days.
                                                  • Without a Thai number you cannot get Thai SMS codes, for example for TrueMoney.
                                                  • Keep your home SIM on for bank SMS codes, with its data roaming off.
                                                  • Airalo is not in the Russian App Store (checked Oct 2026).

                                                  R

                                                  Revolut

                                                  Money and payments

                                                  Card and app like Wise. Change money to baht in the app, then pay by card or take cash at Thai ATMs. Take Wise or Revolut; you do not need both.

                                                  At home
                                                  Order the card early and add it to Apple Pay or Google Wallet. Check 'Your plan' or 'Your limits' in the app for your free limits. Change some money to THB on a weekday.
                                                  Works
                                                  Anywhere Visa or Mastercard is taken: Phuket, Koh Samui, Koh Phangan and Phuket airport. Cash works at any Thai bank ATM.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Free Standard plan (UK and EU, Oct 2026): exchange up to 1,000 GBP or EUR a month with no extra fee, then 1%; 1% extra at weekends; free ATM up to 200 GBP or EUR or 5 withdrawals a month, then 2%.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • Standard plan: exchanges from Friday 17:00 to Sunday 18:00 New York time cost 1% more. In Thailand in January that is Saturday 05:00 to Monday 06:00.
                                                  • Plus plan: 0.5% weekend fee. Premium, Metal and Ultra: no weekend fee and a higher free ATM amount (Premium UK: 400 GBP a month).
                                                  • The Thai ATM fee (250 baht, ≈2,700 AMD Visa, 350 baht, ≈3,800 AMD Mastercard) comes on top. Take out larger amounts.
                                                  • If a card machine offers your home currency, say no and pay in THB.
                                                  Revolut: exchange fees and weekend fee ↗Revolut Standard plan fees (UK) ↗

                                                  A

                                                  Apple Pay (Wallet app) / Google Wallet

                                                  Money and payments

                                                  Pay with your phone, using your foreign card, at card machines that take contactless payments.

                                                  At home
                                                  Add your Wise, Revolut or bank card to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet at home. Your bank may send a code to your home number.
                                                  Works
                                                  Card machines with the contactless symbol: malls, 7-Eleven, hotels and bigger restaurants in Phuket, Samui and Koh Phangan. Markets, street food, small bars and taxis usually want cash or Thai QR.
                                                  Cost
                                                  No fee from Apple or Google. Your card's normal rate and fees apply.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • Thailand is not on Apple Pay's country list, so Thai bank cards cannot be added. Your foreign card still works where the machine shows the contactless symbol.
                                                  • 7-Eleven takes cards and phone payments only from 200 baht (≈2,200 AMD). Pay smaller amounts in cash.
                                                  • Apple says some machines show the symbol but are not set up for contactless. Then use the plastic card or cash.
                                                  • If the machine offers your home currency, choose THB.

                                                  Install it and save Kamala, Ban Tai (Koh Phangan) and Nai Yang as favourites.

                                                  Grab (GrabFood)

                                                  Food and delivery

                                                  Order food from Phuket restaurants to your villa or hotel, in the same Grab app you use for rides. The app works in English.

                                                  At home
                                                  Use the same Grab account as for rides. Add your card and save your villa or hotel address with an exact map pin.
                                                  Works
                                                  Phuket and Koh Samui (Grab's list names Phuket and 'Surat Thani/Samui'). Koh Phangan is not on the list, and local guides say Grab does not run there, so use Delivery KPG.

                                                  Menu prices plus a delivery fee based on distance. You can pick Saver, Standard or Priority delivery.

                                                  • Pay by card in the app, or tap 'Payment method', then 'Cash' at checkout. Paying with a big note? Tell the rider in the chat first.

                                                  • You can order up to 2 days ahead ('Order for later'), or choose Pickup and collect the food yourself to save the delivery fee.

                                                  Ticketmelon

                                                  Parties and tickets

                                                  Thai ticket site and app. It sells Circoloco in baht (Dice sells it in euros). Your QR ticket is in the app and in a PDF sent by email.

                                                  At home
                                                  Make an account with your email, or with Google, Facebook or Apple. Install the app to have the QR on your phone, and keep the email PDF as a backup.
                                                  Works
                                                  Circoloco at Baba Beach Club Natai (9, 16 and 23 Jan) and many other Thai events. Online, anywhere.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Free account. Fees are added at checkout. For Circoloco you can pay by card, PromptPay, TrueMoney or LINE Pay.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • At the door, show the QR in the app ('Tickets', then tap the event poster) or the PDF. Staff may check your ID and give you a wristband.
                                                  • Circoloco on Ticketmelon is set to 20+. Bring your passport.
                                                  • Ticketmelon says you may screenshot the QR, so save it in your photos too. Each QR works once, so never post it online.
                                                  • Ticketmelon does not support resale. Buy only on Ticketmelon or Dice, never from strangers.
                                                  • Names usually cannot be changed. Most events do not check that the name matches your ID, unless the event page says so.
                                                  • All sales are final. Refunds only if the event is cancelled or postponed, and fees are not refunded.

                                                  Eventpop

                                                  Parties and tickets

                                                  Thai ticket app that Waterfall Festival uses. The e-ticket comes by email and sits in the app's Wallet, with your name and a QR code.

                                                  At home
                                                  Sign up with email (or Facebook) and verify your email: without it the QR is hidden. Use your name as in your passport.
                                                  Works
                                                  Waterfall Festival, Ban Tai, Koh Phangan (also sold on Entrix). Online, anywhere.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Free app. The store text lists credit and debit cards, bank transfer and bill payment.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • Show the e-ticket in the app or printed, together with your passport. Eventpop says the ID check depends on the organiser.
                                                  • Some tickets hide the QR behind a countdown until close to the event. Open the app with internet on the day.
                                                  • To give a ticket away (if the event allows it): on the website, 'Tickets', 'View Detail', 'Transfer Ticket'. The friend has 48 hours to accept.
                                                  • Buying for a friend? If you enter their Eventpop email as the ticket holder, the ticket moves to their account and the QR shows there.
                                                  • Keep the QR and reference code private. Anyone with them can enter as you.

                                                  Entrix (entrix.vip)

                                                  Parties and tickets

                                                  Ticket website run by Phangan Events Co. Ltd for Koh Phangan parties: Bambu Sunday Sessions, Waterfall Festival, Retro Mountain and more. The QR ticket comes by email.

                                                  At home
                                                  No app. Buy on entrix.vip with your email. The ticket arrives by email within a minute, and the QR is also in 'My account' when you sign in.
                                                  Works
                                                  Koh Phangan: Bambu (Haad Yuan), Waterfall Festival and Retro Mountain (both Ban Tai). Its Phuket listings only link to other shops, and Samui had none (Oct 2026). Web only, no app.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Prices include the service fee (Bambu from 320 THB, ≈3,500 AMD online, Oct 2026). Pay by card, PromptPay or PayPal, in baht.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • Each ticket has its own single-use QR. Buying for friends? All QRs go to your account, so you can check everyone in together.
                                                  • Do not share screenshots of the QR. Once it is scanned, it cannot be used again.
                                                  • Sales are final unless the event page says otherwise. Ticket Protection at checkout is optional, and service fees are never refunded.
                                                  • The age rule is on each event page under 'Practical'. Bambu and Waterfall show 21+, so bring your passport.
                                                  • Some listings only link to other shops (Megatix, Vibez, GETIN). Then you buy there.
                                                  • Bambu Sunday Sessions run on Sundays. Your Koh Phangan days (Tue 19 to Sat 23 Jan) have no Sunday, so look for a special date.

                                                  A

                                                  Agoda

                                                  Hotels and tours

                                                  Southeast Asian booking app for hotels, villas and guesthouses, part of Booking Holdings (like Booking.com). Compare the two for each stay.

                                                  At home
                                                  Make an account with your passport name and set the currency to baht (THB).
                                                  Works
                                                  All of Thailand: Kamala, Ban Tai on Koh Phangan, Nai Yang near the airport.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Free app. Agoda says the shown price is generally without taxes and service fees, so check the total before you pay.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • Each rate shows how you pay: 'Pay Now', 'Book Now, Pay Later' or 'Pay at Hotel'. Not every hotel offers all of them.
                                                  • Book Now, Pay Later: Agoda charges your card on the date in your confirmation. Pay at Hotel: you pay the hotel, but it may still hold your card or take a deposit.
                                                  • Agoda may add up to 5% if you pay in a different currency from the one on screen. Keep both the same, for example THB.
                                                  • Many cheap rates are non-refundable. Read the cancellation line before you book.
                                                  • Neither Agoda nor Booking.com is always cheaper. Compare the same room and dates on both, and on the hotel's own site.

                                                  TAGTHAi: Thailand Travel App (Easy Pay)

                                                  Money and payments

                                                  Tourist app made with support from TAT. Its Easy Pay wallet from Kasikornbank lets a tourist scan Thai PromptPay QR codes, for example at street food stalls and small shops.

                                                  At home
                                                  Install TAGTHAi, tap Easy Pay and pre-register with your passport, no more than 30 days before you visit the booth. Add a credit or debit card in the app before you fly.
                                                  Works
                                                  QR payments work all over Thailand. You must activate the wallet at a Kasikornbank exchange booth: Patong (Jungceylon, Bangla Road, Banana Walk), Kata, Central Festival Phuket, Samui, Koh Phangan. No booth on the list at Phuket airport.
                                                  Cost
                                                  No application or card fee (TAGTHAi, Oct 2026). Kasikornbank ATM withdrawals free until 31 Dec 2026, then 20 baht (≈220 AMD) each (KBank sheet, June 2026).
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • At the booth show your passport and change foreign cash. The receipt has a 16-digit Wallet ID: enter it with your passport number in Easy Pay, then the 6-digit PIN.
                                                  • To pay: tap Scan & Pay, scan the QR code, type the amount and enter your PIN.
                                                  • KBank sheet (June 2026): paying a person's QR, not a shop, is limited to 1,700 baht (≈18,400 AMD) each time and 50,000 baht (≈540,000 AMD) a month.
                                                  • Ask at the booth how to add money and how to get leftover baht back. KBank says refunds are done at its exchange booths.
                                                  • Store ratings are low (1.6 on the US App Store, 2.3 on Google Play, Oct 2026). Keep cash as a backup.
                                                  Kasikornbank booths for Easy Pay ↗KBank PAY & TOUR sales sheet (limits, fees) ↗
                                                  App StoreGoogle PlayWebsite
                                                  T

                                                  TrueMoney - Pay & Earn Coins

                                                  Money and payments

                                                  Thai e-wallet. A foreigner can register with a passport and pay at 7-Eleven, shops and many QR codes. Only worth it if you get a Thai SIM number.

                                                  At home
                                                  Do it in Thailand after you get a Thai SIM: the code comes by SMS to a Thai number. Choose 'Non-Thai citizen', scan your passport and take a selfie with it. Approval takes 1-3 business days.
                                                  Works
                                                  All of Thailand, including Koh Phangan and Samui. Top up with cash at 7-Eleven counters and top-up kiosks.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Free app. Passport-only account: wallet up to 30,000 baht (≈324,000 AMD), transfers to other TrueMoney users up to 5,000 baht (≈54,000 AMD) a month, no transfers to bank accounts (TrueMoney support, Oct 2026).
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • If the passport check in the app fails, ask a 7-Eleven cashier for 'TrueMoney Passport KYC'.
                                                  • Passport-only accounts cannot send money to bank accounts. Paying a stall's personal PromptPay QR may not work, so test with a small amount first.
                                                  • Airalo and other data-only eSIMs have no Thai number, so they cannot get the TrueMoney SMS code.
                                                  • Without a Thai bank account, top up with cash at 7-Eleven or a top-up kiosk.
                                                  • TrueMoney is not in the Russian App Store (checked Oct 2026).
                                                  TrueMoney: limits for foreigners ↗TrueMoney: how to set up an account ↗
                                                  App StoreGoogle PlayWebsite
                                                  X

                                                  Xe Money Transfer & Currency

                                                  Money and payments

                                                  Live exchange rates and a currency converter. Compare the money changer's board with the real (mid-market) rate before you change cash.

                                                  At home
                                                  Add THB and your home currency to the list.
                                                  Works
                                                  Anywhere with internet. The guide also has its own converter.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Free.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • On 16 Oct 2026 Mamy Exchange in Phuket paid about 0.5-0.9% under the mid-market rate for USD, EUR and GBP. Compare any exchange board with Xe.
                                                  • You do not need the money transfer part of the app for this trip.

                                                  M

                                                  Mamy Exchange (live rates website)

                                                  Money and payments

                                                  Website with the live buy and sell rates of a Phuket money changer with good rates. Check the rate on your phone before you go to change cash.

                                                  At home
                                                  Bookmark mamyexchange.com. You can add their LINE account (@628dltlb) or use WhatsApp to ask a question.
                                                  Works
                                                  Phuket only: one shop at 9/10 Moo 4, Koh Kaew, on route 402 between the airport and Phuket Town. Not at the airport, not on Samui or Koh Phangan.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Free website. Rates on 16 Oct 2026, 15:14: they paid 33.25 baht per USD (50-100 notes), 37.35 per EUR and 44.20 per GBP.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • Big clean notes get the best rate: on 16 Oct 2026 USD 1-2 notes got 32.45 baht, USD 50-100 notes 33.25.
                                                  • Phone: 088-193-1188 or 076-364-111 (Mamy website).

                                                  L

                                                  LINE MAN

                                                  Food and delivery

                                                  Big Thai food delivery app with 700,000+ restaurants, including many small local places. It translates menus into English, and your English chat with the rider reaches them in Thai.

                                                  At home
                                                  The store text says you log in with your LINE account. Make a LINE account at home (SMS code to your phone), then open LINE MAN and save your address.
                                                  Works
                                                  Phuket. LINE MAN says it serves all 77 provinces, but Koh Samui and Koh Phangan coverage is not confirmed.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Free app. The store text says delivery fees start at 0 baht (≈0 AMD) with promotions.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • Try Grab first. Use LINE MAN when a small local place you want is not on Grab.
                                                  • Many discounts are for Thai bank cards. We could not confirm that foreign cards work, so check the payment options before you order.
                                                  • Rider chat is translated: you write in English and the rider sees Thai. There are English chat stickers too.
                                                  English menus and rider chat (LINE MAN news) ↗
                                                  App StoreGoogle PlayWebsite
                                                  D

                                                  Delivery KPG

                                                  Food and delivery

                                                  Food delivery on Koh Phangan, where Grab does not run: 300+ restaurants, cafés and shops, in the app or on the website. Delivery takes about 45 to 60 minutes.

                                                  At home
                                                  Sign up with your WhatsApp number (country code, no '+' or spaces). The code comes by WhatsApp. You can also order on delivery-kpg.com.
                                                  Works
                                                  Koh Phangan only. Each restaurant delivers within its own range, so what you see depends on your address.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Minimum order 200 THB (≈2,200 AMD). The delivery fee depends on your location.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • Pay the driver in cash or by Thai QR code. The FAQ says card payment is only planned, so keep cash.
                                                  • Open 08:00 to 23:45. You can cancel only within 5 minutes, and not once the restaurant starts cooking.
                                                  • Help is on WhatsApp: +66 63 678 2760. Store reviews (2025-2026) mention app bugs and some orders cancelled without notice.
                                                  How it works and FAQ (official) ↗

                                                  W

                                                  Wongnai

                                                  Food and delivery

                                                  Big Thai restaurant review site and app: ratings, photos, menus and prices from Thai diners. Use it as a second opinion next to Google Maps.

                                                  At home
                                                  On iPhone the app is only in the Thai App Store, so use the website. Android has a store listing.
                                                  Works
                                                  Restaurant listings across Thailand, including Phuket.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Free.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • The iPhone app is in the Thai App Store only. A foreign Apple ID cannot download it.
                                                  • For English, open wongnai.com/?locale=en.
                                                  • Many reviews are in Thai. Let your browser translate the page.

                                                  V

                                                  Vibez.io

                                                  Parties and tickets

                                                  Ticket shop and app used by Sacred Moon Phangan for Lost Jungle (Parvati Day & Night, 9 to 11 Jan). Your ticket is a QR code in your Vibez account.

                                                  At home
                                                  Sign up with your phone number. The 4-digit code comes by SMS or WhatsApp; choose WhatsApp if SMS to your number is slow.
                                                  Works
                                                  Lost Jungle, Koh Phangan, 9 to 11 Jan. Buy on web.vibez.io or in the app.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Free app.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • Lost Jungle (9 to 11 Jan) falls in your Phuket group week, before your Koh Phangan days. Check the dates before you buy.
                                                  • Buying for friends? You can assign each ticket to a phone number, and Vibez sends that person a link to their ticket.
                                                  • Find your QR under 'Tickets'. You can also download the QR image.
                                                  • Some events are for members only and ask you to join the organiser's community first.

                                                  G

                                                  GETIN (Get In)

                                                  Parties and tickets

                                                  Ticket site and app used by Utopia, the jungle rave at Than Sadet on Koh Phangan. Tickets live in the GETIN app, with a waiting list and transfers to friends.

                                                  At home
                                                  Only if you go to Utopia. Install GETIN and make the account before you buy, so the ticket shows on your phone.
                                                  Works
                                                  Utopia, Than Sadet, Koh Phangan. January dates were not out on 16 Oct 2026. Online, anywhere.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Free app. Utopia prices are in US dollars (Oct 2026 rounds: USD 65 to 97, door USD 103).
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • Utopia's Oct 2026 page says 18+ and 'Bring ID'. Bring your passport.
                                                  • Cannot go? The app lets you join a waiting list or send the ticket to a friend.
                                                  • Prices rise with each round, so buy early if you are sure.

                                                  H

                                                  Hostelworld

                                                  Hotels and tours

                                                  Hostel booking app with a social side for your solo days: chats with people in your hostel and city, traveller profiles, and 'Linkups', meet-ups like bar crawls, dinners and tours.

                                                  At home
                                                  Install the app, make a profile and book a bed. No hostel booking? Buy a Social Pass in Profile Settings to join the city chats.
                                                  Works
                                                  Hostels in Phuket (the social ones in this guide are in Patong) and on Koh Phangan. City chats for Phuket.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Free app. Social Pass: EUR 4.99 a week or EUR 9.99 a month, a one-time payment, not a subscription (Sep 2026).
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • Hostel and city chats open 7 days before check-in, Linkups 14 days before. Newer app texts call the meet-ups 'Events'.
                                                  • Staying in a hotel near the airport? A 1-week Social Pass opens the Phuket city chat and meet-ups without a hostel booking.
                                                  • Some Linkups cost money, and some hostels ask you to sign up at reception. Read the description.
                                                  • Your bookings are saved in the app for offline use.

                                                  GetYourGuide

                                                  Hotels and tours

                                                  Book tours and day trips with reviews. Most bookings have free cancellation up to 24 hours before, and some let you reserve now and pay later.

                                                  At home
                                                  Make an account and add your card. Tickets are saved in the app and work offline.
                                                  Works
                                                  Phuket tours and day trips. Check listings for Koh Samui and Koh Phangan.
                                                  Cost
                                                  Free app.
                                                  Tips & help
                                                  • Free cancellation up to 24 hours before covers most bookings, not all. Check each listing.
                                                  • 'Reserve now, pay later' holds your spot, and you pay at a later date.
                                                  • Compare the same tour on Klook. Check the pickup area, park fees and meals.
